The '''Weapons Research Facility''' was a private underground research center located on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the facility was under contract to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SWG:TMHP7" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Stephax Dain]], a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] technology-hating [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] organization known as the [[Meatlumps]], launched an ambitious attack on the facility. A rival lieutenant by the name of [[Kaiya Merel]] was not keen on letting Dain take all the credit. She tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to travel to Rori in order to disrupt the facility operations before him. The spacer succeeded in doing so, but ended up killing both Stephax Dain and a number of Meatlump pronks who had already taken over the facility.<ref name="SWG:TMHP7" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:WeaponsResearchFacilityDathomir.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Weapons Research Facility on Dathomir.]]
The Weapons Research Facility was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TMHP7" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Weapons Research Facility was added to the game with the update dubbed "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref>

The Weapons Research Facility appeared in the quest "[[W:c:swg:The Meatlumps Hideout|The Meatlumps Hideout, Part 7]]." If the player started this quest at the end of the game (combat level 90) rather than during the leveling of their character (at CL 65), the research facility would be located on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], a planet for high-level players. Multiple story elements indicated that the quest was intended to be achieved at CL 65.<ref name="SWG:TMHP7" />
